execution_scope: Run only the first eligible pair initially; review actual outcomes before any further collection, training or model change

outcome_rule.guard_stop_or_setup_rejection: Null label and unscored; record reason and phase, exclude from task-outcome metrics.

held_constant: scene, initial object state, random seed and reset-velocity policy
2 ms physics and 40 ms saved control interval

selection_rule.objective: Minimum Euclidean distance of the two last wrist commands to original training mean after original train-only scaling; static geometry gates and distinctness first
selection_rule.priority: Passing actually observed training pairs are preferred; none passes in these declared cases. Otherwise rank all declared grid/refinement candidates by training distance.
selection_rule.tie_break: Ascending WRJ2 then WRJ1 for exactly equal distance
selection_rule.refinement_radius: Initial physical grid spacing, then half and quarter; centered on nearest-training passing candidate including B as a center only, or B if none; physical limits truncate each axis
selection_rule.separation_rationale: Declared before new predictions/outcomes: about one degree in combined wrist command coordinates and comparable to the narrow original WRJ1 command range; avoids numerical near-copy contrasts, without claiming a minimum dynamic or prediction effect
selection_rule.first_pair_selection: First eligible case in the previously declared eight-case order, independent of predictions and outcomes
